diffs.services/proxy/deploy/deployment.yaml:
--- a/services/proxy/deploy/deployment.yaml
+++ b/services/proxy/deploy/deployment.yaml
@@ -41,6 +41,11 @@
               value: /etc/tls/client-ca.crt
             - name: GODEBUG
               value: fips140=only
+            # AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX controls which client certificate SAN suffixes are allowed for remote access.
+            # Comma-separated list. Example: ".example.com,.svc.cluster.local"
+            # Leave empty for no restriction.
+            - name: AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX
+              value: ""
           readinessProbe:
             tcpSocket:
               port: 8080

comments: Client-cert SAN suffix policy is implemented via the AEGIS_PROXY_CLIENT_CERT_SAN_SUFFIX env var, parsed in config.go and enforced in server.go (enforceClientCertSANSuffixPolicy).
The config surface is documented and the env var is wired in deployment.yaml.
Enforcement checks both DNS and URI SANs for allowed suffixes.
Client certificate subject and serial are logged on session.start via logClientCertAudit, called after successful authentication and before session handling.
No regression of TLS1.2+, mTLS, or cipher suite restrictions: server.go Start() still enforces TLS1.2+, mTLS (RequireAndVerifyClientCert), and a restricted cipher suite list.
Deployment.yaml wires the new environment variable with documentation and a default empty value (no restriction).
